$comment: Files in scope of tools/spdx/check-headers.ts that carry no SPDX header, each with the reason. They are still Apache-2.0 under the repository's LICENSE unless the reason says otherwise.

exemptions.reason: Applied migrations are checksum-locked by db/migrate.sh (ledger scf_migrations.applied, sha256) and copied verbatim from docs/data-model.md; adding a line would make every existing database refuse them. Apache-2.0 through LICENSE.
Test inputs (Go convention): their exact bytes are what the tests read.
Test fixtures that must look like the third-party files they imitate (tests/fixtures).

Released tracker versions (tracker.intentional-upgrade, ADR-0004): their exact bytes are pinned by SHA-384 in each release manifest and in tenants' SRI attributes, so no header may be added (never run --fix on them). Apache-2.0 through LICENSE.
